mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_schedule_event WHERE deleted = '0' AND creator_id = #{userId} AND room_id IS NOT NULL AND recurrence_role != 'SERIES' AND status = 'PLANNED' AND start_time > #{now} ORDER BY start_time ASC
SELECT * FROM oa_schedule_event WHERE deleted = '0' AND creator_id = #{userId} AND room_id IS NOT NULL AND recurrence_role != 'SERIES' AND end_time < #{now} ORDER BY start_time DESC
SELECT * FROM oa_schedule_event WHERE deleted = '0' AND creator_id = #{userId} AND room_id IS NOT NULL AND recurrence_role != 'SERIES' ORDER BY start_time DESC

SELECT r.room_id AS roomId, r.name AS roomName, COUNT(e.event_id) AS bookingCount, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, GREATEST(e.start_time, #{startDate}), LEAST(e.end_time, #{endDate}))), 0) AS totalMinutes, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.start_time)) AS usedDays FROM oa_meeting_room r LEFT JOIN oa_schedule_event e ON r.room_id = e.room_id AND r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND e.deleted = '0' AND e.recurrence_role != 'SERIES' AND e.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED') AND e.start_time < #{endDate} AND e.end_time > #{startDate} WHERE r.deleted = '0' GROUP BY r.room_id, r.name ORDER BY bookingCount DESC
